title: Work IQ: invoke custom agents and agents that call third-party tools
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, documented controls and consumption billing are supported. It distinguishes the planned extension from existing controls and does not present those controls as confirmed safeguards for custom-agent or third-party-tool invocation.

claims.claim: The roadmap plans to enable Work IQ to invoke custom agents and agents that call supported third-party tools.
claims.quote: Enable Work IQ to invoke custom agents and agents that call supported third-party tools.

claims.claim: The existing Work IQ MCP ask tool asks Microsoft 365 Copilot a natural-language question.
claims.quote: Asks Microsoft 365 Copilot (or a specific agent) a natural-language question about your data.

claims.claim: Supplying agentId to ask routes the question to that specific agent.
claims.quote: When you provide an `agentId`, the request goes to that specific agent. When you omit it, the request goes to the built-in Microsoft 365 Copilot agent.

claims.where: controls[2].ui; Governance guidance: At rollout; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Individual MCP tools are managed in Microsoft 365 admin center at Agents > Tools > Registry > server > Tools > tool toggle > Save.
claims.quote: Select Agents > Tools, and then select the Registry tab. ... Select an MCP server ... Select the Tools tab. ... an Enabled or Disabled toggle. ... Turn individual tools on or off as needed. ... Select Save

claims.claim: For a server without tool discovery, individual tools cannot be managed in this view and the documented alternative is whole-server blocking.
claims.quote: If an MCP server doesn't support tool discovery ... individual tools aren't available to manage. In this case, use Block or allow an MCP server to control the entire server instead.

claims.claim: An API equivalent for the Agent 365 Tools registry individual-tool toggles is not yet documented.

claims.claim: Tool toggles control individual tools within supported registered MCP servers, rather than the whole server or plugin.
claims.quote: Each toggle applies to the selected tool within the supported MCP server, not to the whole server or plugin package.
